result.label: Graph coloring, clique minors, and Colin de Verdière invariants
result.statement: Disproves Hadwiger's conjecture even for fractional coloring: arbitrarily large finite simple graphs with independence number at most two satisfy (G) h(G), where h(G) is the largest clique-minor order. Also disproves the fractional Colin de Verdière chromatic bound (G) (G)+1. In the positive direction, every finite nonempty graph satisfies list (G) C h(G) for a universal constant C .
